description: Limited, line-oriented lexical rules, not an AST, taint, CVE, or external-tool replacement. Credential literals require at least 12 characters, letters and digits. Comments with a leading comment marker are skipped; embedded comments and strings are not parsed.

rules.title: Credential-like literal assigned to a secret variable
rules.explanation: A named credential variable contains a non-placeholder literal. This lexical match does not establish that the credential is valid.
rules.remediation: Verify the literal; if real, revoke it and load credentials from a managed secret store.

rules.title: Decoded data passed directly to dynamic evaluation
rules.explanation: Direct decode-and-evaluate syntax can conceal executable content. The match alone does not prove malicious intent or input reachability.
rules.remediation: Remove dynamic evaluation; decode and validate data with a non-executable format.

rules.title: Reverse-shell command indicator
rules.explanation: The source contains a command-shaped shell redirection or netcat shell-execution indicator. Stored examples may also match; execution is not inferred.
rules.remediation: Investigate provenance and reachability; remove unauthorized shell/network execution.

rules.title: Explicit authentication-bypass flag enabled
rules.explanation: An explicitly named authentication-bypass flag is enabled. This does not establish whether production code reads the flag.
rules.remediation: Remove the bypass or isolate it to a non-production test harness with mandatory authentication in production.
